name: What preparation is needed before AKN Design Group begins a bathtub installation project?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before AKN Design Group begins a bathtub installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before AKN Design Group begins your bathtub installation project as part of a bathroom renovation, essential preparation involves finalizing material selections, clearing the bathroom space, and ensuring access for our team. Our integrated design-build process includes assisting you with all material selections, from the bathtub itself to tile and fixtures, during the design phase. We also advise on preparing the space, such as clearing personal items. This thorough planning and homeowner preparation streamline the construction phase, allowing our team to efficiently execute the project with precision and craftsmanship, minimizing disruption and ensuring a smooth renovation experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for bathtub installation includes finalizing material selections with our team, clearing the bathroom space, and ensuring access, all managed through our design-build process.
